g.text: Waiting leaves more initial conflicts unresolved
Four agents; no dependency; relocation 0; fixed repair clock. At zero wait: 100%, 100%, 99.8% across the panels.
Pooled finite-window ratios over 30 seeds, not completion-time statistics. Windows are fixed within each p slice.
Ratio intervals are not identified by the aggregate inputs. The dotted vertical line marks 1/μ, not a threshold.
